evals.prompt: Fix three broken PromQL queries written by a developer for our AMG Grafana dashboard: (1) `histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (service) (http_request_duration_seconds_bucket))` (returns `NaN`!), (2) `rate(container_memory_working_set_bytes[5m]) > 0.9` (trying to alert on OOM!), and (3) `increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total[15m])` missing container/pod grouping and `container!=""` cAdvisor filters.
expectations: Activates the prometheus-and-grafana-sre skill

Fixes (1): `http_request_duration_seconds_bucket` is a cumulative counter requiring **`rate(...[5m])` INSIDE `sum by (service, le)`**, and **`le` MUST be included in `by (...)`** for `histogram_quantile` bucket interpolation!

Fixes (2): `container_memory_working_set_bytes` is a **Gauge** (never wrap gauges in `rate()`!), comparing it against `kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="memory"}` (`> 0.90` with `container!="", image!=""` avoiding duplicate pause/POD cgroup hierarchy series), and fixes (3) `sum by (namespace, pod, container) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total[15m])) > 0`
